research_method: Three GPT-6 Luna subagents searched the 110 remaining catalog identities. The primary agent reviewed enableable formats, rejected generic PF*/PP* inference, and checked identity ambiguities. Three initial formats are included from the preceding official-source review. Searches are a bounded public-documentation pass, not proof of absence. Source summaries are paraphrases. Rule examples are synthetic regression cases unless explicitly stated otherwise.

status_definitions.supported: An explicit processor-identifying prefix and merchant suffix is documented by a primary source; a scoped rule is enabled.
status_definitions.unsupported: Reviewed material did not establish a safe extraction rule, for example because descriptors are merchant-configurable, generic, or describe settlements rather than purchases. This does not prove no supported product-specific format exists.
status_definitions.inconclusive: No sufficient primary-source format evidence was found in this search pass, or the catalog identity could not be verified.
status_definitions.not_applicable: Reviewed sources describe an issuing bank, network, infrastructure, or other product role rather than an applicable acquiring descriptor. No catalog reclassification was performed; this is limited to the reviewed evidence.
